entries.name: Grain farm barn and silo
entries.description: Low muted-burgundy timber grain barn, one separate broad slate-blue cylindrical grain silo, and a small open lean-to. The barn footprint is approximately 12m by 8m and its eaves 4m high, ridge 6m; the silo is 9m high. One clearly measured 2.1m personnel door and one broad 4.2m loading opening. Quiet grass around a simple worn farmyard patch. No grain fields.

entries.name: Dairy barn and milk tank
entries.description: Long pale-plaster dairy barn approximately 15m by 7m, 4m eaves, 6m ridge, muted terracotta roof, and one broad low cylindrical silver milk tank beside a small milking shelter. One ordinary 2.1m personnel door and two broad 4.2m agricultural openings. Quiet grass and compact worn farmyard patch. No pasture fields.

entries.name: Produce shed and broad greenhouse
entries.description: One low muted-timber produce shed approximately 7m by 6m and one unmistakable broad glazed greenhouse approximately 10m by 8m. The greenhouse has only a few thick simple structural divisions and soft muted-glass panes. Shed eaves 3m, ridge 4.5m, with one 2.1m personnel door and one broad loading opening. Quiet worn yard grass. No vegetable rows or produce-dot textures.

entries.name: Orchard packing barn and produce shelter
entries.description: Low pale-plaster packing shed approximately 11m by 7m, 3m eaves, 5m ridge, muted terracotta broad pitched roof, a small open packing shelter and three large simple produce bins in restrained ochre/foliage masses. One ordinary 2.1m personnel door. Quiet grass and worn loading patch. No orchard trees, fruit dots, planting rows or fine crate grids.

entries.name: Livestock stable and feeding shelter
entries.description: Broad low L-shaped timber stable approximately 14m by 10m at its extent, 3.5m eaves, 5.5m ridge, subdued slate roof and one small open feeding shelter with broad ochre hay mass. One ordinary 2.1m personnel door and broad agricultural opening. Quiet farmyard grass. No paddock field, surrounding fence or animals.

direction: FARM BUILDING CORE CAMERA CORRECTION. Create a COMPLETELY NEW clean farm core family from the supplied exact 2:1 construction guide and current canonical painted style. Use the guide middle panel for the 2×2 tier. Copy its exact shallow dimetric angle, ground axes, human proportions and muted semantic colours into the new painted barns. The guide is the only image reference; do not copy its flat reference cuboid, its diagram labels or its person. Five occupied cells only in 3 columns by 2 rows, row-major order, slot 6 empty. Each square cell is one registered 2×2 tile 32m farm core cutout inside an independently rendered 5×5 tile farm field plot. Do not duplicate fields or build a full 5 tile farm in these sprites. All architecture lies in a maximum 20m square envelope, whose ground projection is 213.33px wide by 106.67px high in normalized 256 cell: exact vertices (128,138.667),(234.667,192),(128,245.333),(21.333,192). Actual farmyard ground centre stays (128,192). Every wall baseline, barn roof eave, ridge, greenhouse base and canopy beam follows slope +0.500 or -0.500 precisely; vertical edges stay vertical. Every ground line must be visibly twice as wide as it is tall, with a shallow slope of 0.500, not a steep isometric angle. Preserve true world scale: 2.1m door 11.2px high, 0.95m door 5.07px wide, 3m storey 16px, 4.2m loading bay 22.4px in normalized 256 cell. At a 512px source cell these values double. Center grass worn patches around measured farmyard centre, never around alpha extent. Keep ground patches quiet and light with irregular soft grassy edges and NO thick diamond platform, no soil walls, no opaque full parcel card. Preserve generous transparency and gutters. Reduce noise drastically: broad readable barn masses and silos/greenhouses are identity; no tiny roof ribbing, fine window mullions, wood scratches, exposed hay dots, railings, bush fringes or gravel texture. Every family uses the same semantic muted palette and same upright physical scale. Render five farmyards on a genuinely transparent sheet, no labels, gridlines, guide strokes or palette cards in final output. Clean broad flat brush shapes only. Tiny textures and bright saturated greens or bright red roofs are prohibited. NO trees and NO bushes. Barely visible simple grass patch under each barn group, feathered irregular perimeter, no garden border or crisp full-square diamond. The barns, silo, greenhouse and packing shelter must remain broad and recognizable at thumbnail size. Sheet width-to-height 3:2, square cells, ample separation.
